title: Bitcoin rockets above $80,000 for first time since Binance hack despite Democrats sweep, but a historical crash looms
summary: Bitcoin surged more than 5% from its election-night low to reclaim $80,000 for the first time since Binance's record hack. The cryptocurrency extended its recovery from approximately $75,600 on Wednesday, shaking off concerns that Democrats' takeover of Congress would undermine President Donald Trump's crypto-friendly agenda.
